items.criterion: An accepted entry is stored with its counts, its total and its run.
items.judgment: Read the entry back from the store and compare the counts and the total with the send.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous sends carrying one run token leave exactly one entry.
items.judgment: Count the entries for that run after both calls return.

items.criterion: A second send carrying a spent run token is refused with a reason.
items.judgment: Read the status of the second send and the entry count for the run.

items.criterion: A total that disagrees with the counts is refused.
items.judgment: Send the pinned counts with a total of 250 and read the status.

items.criterion: A count above the item maximum is refused.
items.judgment: Send 61 apples and read the status and the store.

items.criterion: An item key left out of the send counts as zero.
items.judgment: Send one key and read the stored counts for the other two.

items.criterion: A fourth run start inside the window is refused.
items.judgment: Start four runs for one player and read the status of the fourth.

items.criterion: A board serves at most ten rows, best first, with consecutive ranks.
items.judgment: Read each board and check the order, the length and the ranks.

items.criterion: Equal totals put the earlier entry first.
items.judgment: Read the two seeded entries on 640 and compare the ranks.

items.criterion: An entry below the tenth place is stored and ranked over the whole game.
items.judgment: Send an empty-handed run and compare the answered rank with the store.

items.criterion: Every tabled seed exists once with its counts and its own spent run.
items.judgment: Read the seeded entries and their runs from the store.

items.criterion: The event stream opens with the current board.
items.judgment: Open the stream and compare the first event with the plain request.

items.criterion: A new entry reaching the top ten is pushed to an open stream.
items.judgment: Hold the stream open and send a full run on that game.

items.criterion: An entry below the top ten or on another game pushes nothing.
items.judgment: Hold one stream open and send entries that belong elsewhere.

items.criterion: A name outside the length, character or letter rule is refused.
items.judgment: Send each invalid name and read the status and the store.

items.criterion: A reserved word in a name is refused whatever its case or accents.
items.judgment: Send the reserved spellings and read the status.

items.criterion: A name is trimmed and its inner spaces collapsed before storage.
items.judgment: Send a padded name and read the stored value.

items.criterion: A removed name keeps the row, the total and the rank.
items.judgment: Remove a name as the owner and read the row and the board.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated removal is denied and changes nothing.
items.judgment: Call the removal with no token and read the stored name.

items.criterion: A token the app never issued is denied on both owner endpoints.
items.judgment: Call the listing and the removal with a forged token.

items.criterion: The listing behind a board is owner-only and carries the stored names.
items.judgment: Call the listing with and without the owner token.

items.criterion: The seeded owner signs in and receives a bearer token.
items.judgment: Post the seeded credentials and use the token on an owner endpoint.

items.criterion: A wrong password is denied and the stored password is hashed.
items.judgment: Post a wrong password and read the account row.

items.criterion: Each game lists its items with the tabled worth and maximum.
items.judgment: Read the games index and compare every item against the table.

items.criterion: A run start stores an unused run bound to its game and player.
items.judgment: Start a run and read the row behind the token.

items.criterion: An entry whose game differs from the run's game is refused.
items.judgment: Send a ski entry with an orchard token.

items.criterion: The first document carries the loading layer, the word and all six tips.
items.judgment: Fetch the route and read the served markup.

items.criterion: The document declares French while the title and the description declare English.
items.judgment: Read the language attributes and the metadata of the served document.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers 404 with the pinned words and no script.
items.judgment: Fetch an unknown path and read the status and the markup.

items.criterion: The seeded reserved name is stored as written and served anonymously.
items.judgment: Read the stored row and the served board row.
